metadata.scenario: A returning patient calls to schedule their bi-weekly wound care visit. They request Tuesday morning if possible. The receptionist books them for Tuesday at 10 AM. Quick, friendly call.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Jennifer Taylor. I'm calling to schedule a bi-weekly wound care visit for my grandmother. Hi, Jennifer! It’s great to hear from you. When would you like to schedule that visit? We were hoping for Tuesday morning, if that's possible. Let me check the schedule for our wound care nurse. Just a moment, please. Sure, take your time. I see we have availability on Tuesday at 10 AM. Does that work for you? Yes, that’s perfect! Great! I’ll book that for you. Can I confirm the address for the visit? Yes, it’s 123 Elm Street, right in Wichita. Got it, 123 Elm Street. And may I have your grandmother's name? Her name is Evelyn Taylor. Thank you, Jennifer. I’ve scheduled your appointment for Tuesday at 10 AM for Evelyn. Thank you so much, Margaret. I really appreciate it. You're welcome! Is there anything else you’d like to discuss while I have you on the line? Actually, I was wondering if you offer any companion care as well? Yes, we do offer companion care services. They include assistance with daily activities and social interaction. That sounds helpful. How much do those services cost? Companion care is priced at $25 to $30 per hour. Would you like to discuss scheduling that as well? Yes, I’d like to set that up for a couple of days a week, maybe starting next week. Absolutely! Let me get you in touch with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, who can assist with that. That sounds good. Thank you! I’ll connect you with Lisa, and she will help you develop a care plan that fits your needs. Thank you again, Margaret. I appreciate your help! You're very welcome, Jennifer! If you need anything else, feel free to reach out. Will do! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye! Goodbye!
